title: Maid Dimension
description: Add beautiful personal dimensions for Touhou Little Maid! Create your own safe haven with full control over rules, entities, and more. Highly configurable for survival balance.
body:
Maid Dimension The Homeland of Maids — Fully Configurable Personal Dimensions for Touhou Little Maid

Maid Dimension expands Touhou Little Maid with fully configurable personal dimensions designed for survival, multiplayer, and long-term progression.

The Maid Dimension is the homeland of many maids — a peaceful sanctuary where maids and their trusted owners have complete control over who may enter and what rules govern the dimension. Earn a maid’s trust to gain access to your own personal dimension and shape it into a peaceful home or customizable survival base.

Every major mechanic is designed for survival progression with meaningful costs, but everything can be fully customized — or disabled entirely — through server configuration for creative play or multiplayer servers.

Main Features
🏠 Private or shared Maid Dimensions
🌸 Three distinct world generation types
⚙️ Fully customizable dimension rules
🚪 Owner-bound Okina's Door with player permissions
🛡️ Active dimension protection for maids and entities
🐈 Three powerful baubles, including the Cat Familiar
👥 Designed for both singleplayer and multiplayer
🔧 Extensive server-side configuration
Accessing the Dimension

Reach Favorability Level 3 with a maid to receive Okina’s Door — a personal teleportation item permanently bound to its owner that displays the owner's name in its tooltip.

Shift + Right Click teleports supported living entities. Bosses cannot be teleported by default for balance. All costs, cooldowns, permissions, and entity teleportation are fully configurable.

Customize Your Dimension

Using the Maid GUI or server configuration, you can modify many rules, including:

Disable hunger, death, harmful effects, or block breaking
Make selected hostile mobs neutral
Allow maids to teleport with their owner across dimensions
Adjust join/leave cooldowns and teleportation costs
And many more

Powerful rules have high default costs to preserve survival progression.

Three World Types
Maid Island — A peaceful floating island suspended above the void
Cherry World — A beautiful Cherry biome where vanilla and modded structures generate naturally
Overworld Reflection — A mirror of the Overworld generated with its own independent seed
Dimension Protection

The Maid Dimension actively enforces its own rules:

Unwanted entities are blocked from entering and can be expelled back to the Overworld or permanently deleted (configurable)
Wild maids automatically defend themselves from otherwise fatal attacks by expelling or deleting the attacker (configurable)
Tamed maids protect their owner from lethal damage when nearby
New Baubles
🌸 Cherry Blossom - Domain Expansion — Temporarily brings/extends part of the Maid Dimension into the Overworld ( OR your actual dimension ) in a limited way, applying selected rules inside range while consuming XP.
🌸 Cherry Touch — Transforms nearby terrain into Cherry variants while applying in a limited way selected dimension rules.
🐈 Cat Familiar — A loyal black cat that follows its maid across dimensions. Provides cat reflexes with dodge chance, reduced fall damage, enemy detection, combat support, stat mirroring, and automatic revival it also add interactions between cat and maid like cute interactions that increase maid favorability and heal cat. Nearly every aspect is configurable.
Tethered Teleport — Teleports the maid with you when you teleport to a dimension.
Multiplayer & Configuration

Designed with multiplayer in mind, featuring private or shared dimensions, player permissions, entity whitelists/blacklists, and player-configurable settings through the Maid GUI. Supports automatic Yes Steve Model (YSM) assignment for naturally spawned maids. Server administrators retain full control over configuration options. Fully configurable Mod to fit your gameplay, don't like something? disable it, wanna decrease or increase costs? you can change it, cooldown too big? decrease, do you prefer the dimension to have monsters or not? change it as you prefer both adidng in config with no costs for everyone or adding it in maid GUi with or without costs as you prefer, don't want players to have access to OP dimension rules in their maid GUI? you can disable it in server side config, don't like configuring? the mod have balanced default values. All to fit your play style.

Languages: English + 中文翻译

Suggestions, bug reports, balance feedback, and feature requests are always welcome!
